mandatory_findings.title: Decimal suffix trimming is quadratic in valid bounded numeric input

contract_source.quote: Coeficientes e trabalho permanecem lineares no input bounded.

mandatory_findings.observation: All four finite Number( token ) = 0.1 inputs correctly reject loss of decimal value, but runtime scales approximately fourfold when n doubles. The unanchored /0+$/ restarts across a long internal run of zeros before the final 1. This violates the specified linear work bound and occupies the synchronous event loop before rejection.

criteria.evidence_summary: Actual original catalog 487+22, 22 declared families, exact baseline proposal bytes; synthetic additive control-only new family accepted after reviewer fixture correction; progress claims do not grant parity.

Integrity precedes origin/authority; forged fixture/identity/collector/timeout receipts fail origin; authenticated timeout is INFRA_FAILURE; denied/pending/scope authority blocked.
Body, order, error, effects, identity and cost differences mismatch with digests; cost remains protected with valid ID normalization.
Unsafe integers rejected by JSON; adjacent i64 and signed zero remain byte-distinct; identical out-of-domain bytes remain eligible.

Exact-decimal semantic tests pass, including ordinary finite numbers, safe integer edges, -0 variants, underflow/huge exponents and lossy metadata before normalization. Mandatory linear-cost invariant fails at R1-01.

Read path reuses unchanged safe-io guards: symlink authority/input/output, traversal, directory/FIFO special input, 4MiB artifact and 1MiB catalog cap+1, exclusive output. First fd snapshot remains detached when path is replaced; original handle/snapshot protocol statically inspected. Full publication race matrix was not independently rerun.

Nine freeze hashes stable, original 40 C100 preimages identical; only three authorized shared candidate sources differ from those preimages. Catalog/rule/spec/origin tampering rejected; no promotion or old credit transfer.

Broad gates/PG/E2E/certification are outside this independent code review; global acceptance stays pending.
